service.description: Feedback across tenants, unanswered first then newest: [feedbackId, tenant: [id, name], statement, cause, record, note, sentBy, sentAt, ageDays, answer, answeredAt]. unansweredOnly (default true) leaves out the answered ones.

Answers one piece of feedback by email to its sender (their note quoted, then the answer) and saves the answer. A second reply overwrites the answer and sends again. Refuses a blank answer and an unknown id; if the mail is not sent, nothing is saved.

return.message: The answer to ${feedbackId} was not emailed, so it was not saved.

service-call.name: update#darpan.audit.AuditFindingFeedback
service-call.in-map: [feedbackId: feedbackId, answer: text, answeredByUserId: ec.user.userId, answeredStamp: answeredStamp]

service-call.name: create#darpan.admin.AdminAuditLog
service-call.in-map: [adminUserId: ec.user.userId, serviceName: 'admin.FeedbackAdminServices.reply#Feedback', targetType: 'AuditFindingFeedback', targetId: feedbackId, detailText: 'Answered feedback ' + feedbackId + ' of ' + feedback.companyUserGroupId + ' by email.', auditTimestamp: answeredStamp]
